reviewer: Counsel decision relayed by the owner (A44 and A46 Legal Decision Record, 2026-10-21); implementation by GA1217 under lead option (b)
decisionText: Section 15-27-1(b)(3) is interpreted according to its enacted disjunctive language. A qualifying applicant who held a commercial driver's license but was not operating a commercial motor vehicle at the time of the offense satisfies that specific condition. The associated memorandum and question logic may be corrected, subject to normal release acceptance.

supersededReading.text: If the conviction is for an offense enumerated in 49 C.F.R. § 383.51, the person must not have been operating a commercial motor vehicle and must not have held a CDL or CLP at the time of the offense.

controllingReading: If the conviction is for an offense enumerated in 49 C.F.R. § 383.51, the person must not have been operating a commercial motor vehicle, or must not have held a CDL or CLP, at the time of the offense.
